{{Top|leg}}
An '''Off-World Visitation Intent data disk''' was a required form for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] intending to land on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Algara II]]. The data disk required that name and planet of origin of each crew member, name, type, and planet of registration for the ship, the last port of call, cargo manifest, and the crew's intentions while visiting Algara II. A ten [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] filing fee was required.
